LESSON: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: COMPREHENSION STRATEGIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do you remember most after reading a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify mental images in a text correctly
2. use contextual clues to infer information and meanings of words correctly in a text

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: COMPREHENSION STRATEGIES
This lesson teaches Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify mental images in a text correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use contextual clues to infer information and meanings of words correctly in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies above.
2. Explain Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you remember most after reading a text?
2. How do we get information from a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify mental images in a text correctly
2. use contextual clues to infer information and meanings of words correctly in a text
